about_the_game:
In a dying world where gods lie murdered and the void devours what remains, lead a band of broken heroes called Primals: warriors born from divine bloodlines, awakened through trauma, and bound by purpose. UnGodly combines real-time combat, team-based hero swapping, and relationship-driven progression into a single, high-fidelity RPG experience.

Tarsea is a realm of corrupted beauty where the last survivors of fallen empires claw meaning from ruin. The Crooked Crown bleeds the people for profit while the Lucid Temple turns pleasure into sacrifice and the Twilight Sun worships annihilation. Travel through these broken dominions, from gambling dens built atop dying cities to witch-haunted swamps and marble halls of heresy, encountering factions that embody humanity's worst instincts alongside rare glimpses of redemption.

Combat in UnGodly is fast, deliberate, and brutal. Command four Primals in battle, swapping between them seamlessly to chain elemental powers and crush enemies in cinematic clashes. Every strike carries weight, every dodge is a decision, and victory must be earned. There are no idle battles here, only the rush of power meeting resistance in a world that wants you dead.

Recruit powerful Primals, each with distinct abilities, elements, and combat roles. Build and refine your roster to create teams that fit your playstyle, whether you favor precise tactical control or all-out elemental destruction. Swap heroes seamlessly in real time, experiment with combinations, and discover synergies that turn every battle into a showcase of skill and strategy. Strengthen your roster through upgrades, gear, and mastery to unlock new layers of depth, forcing you to adapt your approach and bring out the full potential of your team with every encounter.

The Affinity System turns trust into strength. When two Primals fight side by side, their bond deepens, unlocking new attacks, dialogue, and emotional revelations. Some connections grow into friendship, others into rivalry or something far more complicated. Over time, those bonds reshape your team and reveal who these heroes truly are and who they might become together.

UnGodly is built for players who crave a world worth returning to. Its short, meaningful sessions blend exploration, story, and strategy into a rhythm that feels satisfying every day. Beneath the violence lies purpose, and beneath the ruins, a spark of hope.

Step into the world of UnGodly, the dark fantasy that remembers why role-playing mattered in the first place.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of fantasy violence and mature themes. Combat is visceral, with blood effects and occasional dismemberment when striking corrupted enemies. Certain storylines include implied sexual situations shown through stylized, comic-book illustrations of characters in bed, and references to alcohol use and an addictive fantasy substance known as “Rose.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 (4+ cores)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX 570 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-13900K or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 or AMD RX 7800 XTX with 24GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
